U7/Ancient/Mutant

Requires: Super Saiyan 2, Legendary Super Saiyan, or Controlled Super Saiyan and True Saiyan Rage Feat You learn to mix Super Saiyan and your Ozaru's Power into your base form, manifesting it into a new form. You gain the Super Saiyan 4 Transformation.
